verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API platform, so a documented per-key rate limit is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documented requests-per-second or per-minute limit and no description of throttling behavior. The 'thousands of concurrent browser sessions' marketing claim is about concurrency scale, not a published rate limit, and the OpenAPI spec and playground evidence do not mention one.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the documented rate limit (requests per second or minute) enforced on my API key before throttling kicks in
